title: Measure nODD repository size at current main
limitations: Actual conversation start time and exact per-turn token counters were not exposed; usage remains empty rather than estimated.
Counts exclude the 13 pinned submodule contents, ignored artifacts, build products, and other worktrees.
Text lines include generated JSON and SVG, blank lines and comments; source totals are physical lines rather than language-aware executable-code counts.
Git disk usage depends on available branches, worktrees and object packing.

activities.name: functions.exec / exec_command
activities.evidence: Read-only Git archive, ls-tree, disk usage and Python standard-library counting; isolated worktree and journal publication.

activities.name: GitHub connector
activities.evidence: Read current main branch and repository size metadata from the connected GitHub service.

checks.command: git archive 78bef505c4e623739da204ce92e3aa7bc6f931c5 with Python tarfile counting; independent git ls-tree -rlz cross-check
checks.result: Both paths counted 5298 tracked blobs totaling 601300442 bytes; 13 gitlinks excluded. Text physical lines: 7474487. Source and build-script physical lines: 107854.

checks.command: git worktree add from parent workspace; retry in nODD main clone
checks.result: Initial invocation in the parent workspace could not resolve origin/main (exit 128); corrected working directory and created an isolated clean worktree at the exact measured commit.

checks.command: Documented Python reproduction extracted from session Markdown and compared against repo-size.json
checks.result: All/text/binary/source file, byte and physical-line counts match retained measurements.
305 sessions; 589 historical recorded turns with observed input 3319239723 and output 13881824. This task has no observed usage and is excluded from these sums.
Build passed with 589 disjoint historical turns; generated output kept outside Git.

checks.command: GitHub connector create_pull_request; gh pr create fallback
checks.result: Connector rejected repository parameter schema; first gh call was network-blocked in sandbox; escalated retry created draft PR https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/158. Connector GET independently verified draft=true and open state.

checks.command: python3 -B tools/interactions/ledger.py capture --pr 158 --snapshot /private/tmp/nodd-size-pr-snapshot.json; python3 -B tools/interactions/ledger.py validate
checks.result: Captured sanitized connected-GitHub metadata, with no comments/reviews, and validated all 124 PR interaction records; canonical usage unchanged.
